maintenance_led.reason: Sells canned and packaged fruits and vegetables, consumable food products, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from retail, foodservice, and industrial customers, plus some government food programs, but mostly private buyers.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own vertically integrated processing and sales of canned vegetables, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Canned fruits and vegetables are largely commodity or private-label food; retailers and foodservice buyers can switch suppliers easily.
